annotations.title: Get a lawyer's profile and sources

description: Use when the user wants details on one lawyer from a match. Returns license status with its official source and check date, private-client intake evidence, practice areas, service area, fees, availability, languages, data freshness, the directory profile link and a suggested citation. Also returns the exact consent text to show before an introduction.
name: get_attorney_profile
